title: The Collapsed Chapel
text: A chapel folded in on itself, as if a great hand had closed around it and squeezed. The bell lies crushed among the beams. From somewhere under the stones a warm light leaks out through the cracks, steady as a lamp that someone is still tending.

options.label: The strongest digs for the light, hoping whatever tends it will be grateful.

outcomes.text: Beneath the altar stone lies a reliquary of grey ash, warm to hold, like a hand that has only just let go.
The rest of the roof comes down on them. The light goes out beneath the rubble, which pins their legs until the others dig them free.

options.label: Pray among the ruins, and hope that something here still listens.

outcomes.text: The light dims gently, as if satisfied. A deep quiet settles over the ruin.
Nothing answers. The light keeps leaking through the stones, steady and indifferent to your prayers.

options.label: Leave it to its god. Whatever keeps that lamp burning is not your concern.

outcomes.text: As you skirt the ruin, the light follows beneath the ground. Where it passes under the Leader, their wounds begin to knit.
The light follows you beneath the ground. That night it presses up under the Leader like a face; they wake with it burned into their eyes.
